blocks.text: Multiple deadlines, back-to-back exams, bills that all seem to be due at once, and a to-do list that never ends. Some days, life feels like it’s just too much. Bioderm, the homegrown soap brand all about feeling fresh and blooming, showed how its Bioderm Bloom soap could help ease the load with its Two Much campaign, which culminated at The Blooming Experience. The event came to life last Friday, November 13, when Bioderm threw the ultimate celebration as pink hues and fresh energy took over the TriNoma Activity Center.
